output.answer: Research question: What evidence and constraints must govern phase-one preparation of the synthetic wafer report? The primary export supports a planned calculation of 1 defective wafer out of 4 distinct wafers, or 25%, for 2025-04-01 UTC. Manual review disagrees about W13; preserve the primary result and disclose both observations. The required preparation.md remains to be written by an authorized implementer: this researcher may not write outside .opencode/runs/**. No final report was created.
constraints: Work only in the fixture workspace; do not access credentials, change global configuration, install packages or use network services.
Preserve supplied evidence, skills and visible tests.
The researcher may write only under .opencode/runs/**; writing root-level preparation.md requires an authorized implementer.
Stop after phase-one preparation; do not create report.json or implement the final deliverable.

evidence.finding: Primary source SYS-APR-01 identifies reporting_date_utc as 2025-04-01.
Five rows cover four distinct wafers: W11, W12, W13 and W14. W12 appears twice, in S-202 and S-203, and is the only distinct wafer marked defective.
Supplemental source MR-APR-01 has the same reporting date. It agrees that W12 is defective but records W13 reviewer_defect=true with a visual-mark note; system event S-204 records W13 defect=false.

The active skill requires UTC inclusive-start/exclusive-end windows, distinct-wafer denominators, primary system-export precedence, explicit conflicts, source names, calculation and the exact synthetic-analysis limitation.
